releases.notes:
## Mob Highlighter 1.0.0

**Minecraft 26.1.2 · Fabric**

Highlight a selected mob type so you can see all nearby mobs of that type using the vanilla glow outline — visible through walls, compatible with Iris shaders.

### Usage
- Look at a mob and press **H** to start tracking that mob type
- All mobs of that type within 64 blocks glow with the vanilla outline effect
- Press **H** again (or press it while not looking at a mob) to clear the highlight
- A HUD counter shows the mob name and count within range

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API 0.148.0+26.1.2
- Java 25

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Hackatoan/mob-highlighter/commits/v1.0.0
